description: ESD protection on the BREATH and AGND legs
notes: *** 12V STANDOFF, NOT 5V. *** BREATH's normal top of range is sensor-full-scale, which leaves only 140mV of margin against a 5V array's V_RWM, on the project's DC-accurate output. Worse, ADR 0003's buffer-on-+12V decision exists precisely so a SUSTAINED +12V fault on BREATH is harmless - a 5V clamp turns that designed-safe case into a part that conducts until something fails. PESD12VS1UA,115 (LCSC C131084), SOD-323: VRWM 12 V, VBR 13.3 V min [ds NEXPERIA-PESD12VS1UA.pdf p.5], so a sustained +12 V does not conduct; leakage 100 nA max at 12 V, 0.1 mV across the 1k [calc]. NOT THE UB: PESD12VS1UB is SOD523 [ds NEXPERIA-PESD12VS1UB.pdf p.1], 0402-class. The UA's 180 pF max behind the 1k is a pole at 0.88 MHz, far above the breath band [calc]
